description: This PHP source file defines the AccessTokenRepository class, which manages OAuth2 access tokens within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for persisting, revoking, validating, and creating new access tokens, implementing the OAuth2 server's access token repository interface.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing OAuth2 access tokens, including persistence, revocation, validation, and creation functionalities, integrating with Doctrine ORM and OAuth2 server interfaces.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Persists a new access token entity into the database, handling potential unique constraint violations.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks an access token as revoked in the database based on the token ID.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a given access token has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth2 access token entity linked to a client and optional scopes and user identifier.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token entity from the database by token ID.
